title: Round tube end plug
prompt: End plug for 25 mm round tube with a 1.5 mm wall: a 10 mm long spigot that goes inside (21.8 mm diameter, a bit under the 22 mm ID), a 3 mm thick cap flush with the tube's 25 mm outside, and a gently domed top rising 3 mm above the cap edge (spherical).

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
25 mm diameter, 16 mm tall overall, ±0.1 mm
The domed top is one spherical face
Two cylindrical faces: spigot and cap edge
Volume spigot + cap + 3 mm spherical cap ≈ 5955.6 mm³ ±1%

notes: Dome sphere radius 27.54 mm (through the cap edge and the apex, centred on the axis).
